official_domain: Connected simple undirected graph; 1-based vertices; 2 <= n <= 400000; 1 <= m <= 400000; no loops or parallel edges
objective: Maximize minimum reachable-vertex count, including the starting vertex
output: Optimum followed by m directed endpoint pairs in original logical edge order; optimum orientation is nonunique
resource_precondition: Existing recursive BiconnectedCore DFS/paint and orient_edges require sufficiently large process stack, potentially linear in n. A local 8 MiB path run failed by SIGSEGV. Normal tests request 256 MiB and instrumented sanitizer tests request 1 GiB child soft RLIMIT_STACK capped by the existing hard limit; a sanitizer 256 MiB path run also overflowed; this is test provisioning, not a proven universal requirement or known Codeforces judge stack. Published main does not change process limits. Local RSS and sanitizer overhead do not establish judge acceptance.
coverage: Application uses EdgeCompression.size and .edges; .inside remains covered by the separate API tests
online_status: No submission or online acceptance claimed
